text:
Arjun Patel: Heads-up — PR #8421 needs a second approver before the midnight cutover. Merge is blocked until we get 2x signoffs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pplat/pull/8421
Sophie Chen: On it. Quick question: can someone sanity-check the migration toggle? I skimmed, looks OK but want one more eye on the KV cache flip.
Liam O'Connor: I can take a look in ~20m. Anything specific to run locally?
Arjun Patel: Thanks. Run `scripts/smoke.sh --kv-cache` and check canary metrics in grafana (https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/kv-warmup). Main risk is the warmup flag accidentally disabling prefetch.
Maya Rivera: :eyes: Seeing a flaky test on CI, rerunning now.
deploy-bot: CI rerun triggered by Maya — build/8421#retry (started)
Sophie Chen: If CI comes back green I'm fine approving. Left a couple non-blocking comments about logging.
Liam O'Connor: CI is green now. Approved — leaving comment: "2nd-eye ✅". @Arjun do you have merge perms?
Arjun Patel: I do, but prefer to wait till the canary threshold stabilizes for ~10m. If metrics look good I'll merge and watch.
Taylor Nguyen: I'm on-call, can monitor the canary and coordinate rollback if needed. Ping me and I'll trigger the rollback window.
Arjun Patel: Ok merging in 5m unless issues. Thanks everyone. Merge commit: abc123def (will monitor). :rocket:
